# cairn admin workflow simulate-crash

Enqueue + lease + heartbeat a synthetic job, then exit without releasing so the row is left in state='leased' with an expired lease.

## Help

```text
Enqueue + lease + heartbeat a synthetic job, then exit without releasing so the row is left in
state='leased' with an expired lease.

Usage: simulate-crash [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --kind <STRING>
          Workflow kind discriminator (default: test.e2e.orphan)

      --lease-ms <I64>
          Lease duration in ms (default: 100; short so it expires fast)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
